title: Edge Firewall, Switches & Network Telemetry
steps: Identify target network device via zabbix_host_get.
Read gauge metrics directly (active sessions, CPU, memory).
For monotonic/cumulative counters (interface bytes, drops, IPS blocks): fetch a time series via zabbix_history_get or zabbix_trend_get and compute the delta over the window.
avoid: Do NOT query SigNoz for pure L2/L3 network gear that only reports SNMP to Zabbix.
Do NOT treat cumulative counter raw totals as a burst inside the current window.
